 local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera

 local fov=if _G.VAngle=="body" then 48 else 38
 local m=_G.VTarget
 if m and m.Parent then
  local h=m:FindFirstChild("Head")

   local p=h.Position
   local forward=h.CFrame.LookVector
   local right=h.CFrame.RightVector
   local distance=math.max(h.Size.X,h.Size.Y,h.Size.Z)
   local focus=p
   local offset=forward*distance*4.8
   if mode=="body" then
    local left,rightFoot=m:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot"),m:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
    if left and rightFoot and left:IsA("BasePart") and rightFoot:IsA("BasePart") then
     local bottom=math.min(left.Position.Y-left.Size.Y*0.5,rightFoot.Position.Y-rightFoot.Size.Y*0.5)
     local top=p.Y+h.Size.Y*0.5
     focus=Vector3.new(p.X,(bottom+top)*0.5,p.Z)
     local flat=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
     if flat.Magnitude>0.01 then forward=flat.Unit end
     offset=forward*math.max(distance*5,(top-bottom)*1.45)
    else focus=p-Vector3.new(0,distance*0.85,0) offset=forward*distance*9 end
   elseif mode=="side" then offset=right*distance*4.8+Vector3.new(0,distance*0.16,0)
